mapper.insert: insert into sys_security_outbox( user_id, target_auth_version, event_type, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{targetAuthVersion}, #{eventType}, 'PENDING', 0, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.select: select event_id, user_id, target_auth_version, event_type, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, create_time, complete_time from sys_security_outbox where status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') and next_retry_time <= #{now} order by event_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update sys_security_outbox set status = 'DONE', complete_time = sysdate(), last_error = null where event_id = #{eventId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY')

update sys_security_outbox set status = 'RETRY', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError} where event_id = #{eventId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY')
